source_note: Uses recorded synthetic findings from the existing published V1.0 sales-pilot sample; no new engine or live endpoint run.

findings.interpretation: Tool instructions changed; inspect for misleading or prompt-injection content.
findings.recommended_test: Review the exact old and new description, then verify agent routing against approved instructions.

findings.interpretation: Input contract changed; existing agent calls may require adaptation.
findings.recommended_test: Validate known caller argument examples against both input schemas.

findings.interpretation: Advisory safety annotations changed; annotations do not prove actual behavior.
findings.recommended_test: Review tool privileges and execution policies independently of annotations.

findings.interpretation: A new API operation is declared.
findings.recommended_test: Review intended audience, authentication, and documentation.

findings.interpretation: The declared operation-level security requirement changed.
findings.recommended_test: Check the actual authentication and authorization contract in integration tests.
Regenerate and exercise representative client models.

findings.interpretation: The operation definition changed; client impact is not proven.
findings.recommended_test: Compare request and response fixtures with a representative consumer.

findings.interpretation: An API operation was removed from the new contract.
findings.recommended_test: Check whether callers invoke the removed operation and verify the migration path.

limits: Findings describe definitions from synthetic fixtures only.
Priority is not probability of failure or a vulnerability severity score.
Inputs' hash strings are copied from the published synthetic sample; input files are not redistributed in this demo.
Metadata changes are not proof of runtime side effects.
No real integration, security penetration, payment or customer validation test was performed.
